text:
maria: FYI -- noticed elevated 5xx on canary after the 10:02 deploy, EU region primarily. Canary pass rate dropped to ~60% in last 2m. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-0423-01 — canary failures after deploy. Paging oncall.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2024-04-23T10:02Z finished for release v1.12.3 (commit abc123).
alex: I'm oncall, looking. Any quick errors or stack traces?
maria: Logs show tokenizer exceptions + OOMs on g4dn-like nodes, but mostly 502s from runtime service. snippet: `RuntimeError: kv_cache resize failed at ctx 1024`
pranav: That commit (abc123) was the small batching change + kernel switch. Could be kernel selection fallback for shorter sequences.
jen: Repro locally with canary config? I can spin up a canary with the exact config.
pranav: Try flipping the new batching flag first (feature flag `enable_new_batcher`). If that removes pressure we can avoid revert.
maria: Where is the flag toggle for that env?
alex: It's a remote config in `infra-config/prod/canary`. I can flip to `false` with the console or via curl. Doing console now.
alex: flipped `enable_new_batcher=false` for canary tier. Waiting 45s for draining.
maria: Metrics: success rate climbing to 92% within 30s. Latency stabilizing. Looks promising.
jen: Nice. Are we confident no downstream regressions? We need to check embeddings/rerank jobs for correctness.
pranav: Flag flip confirms batching path was introducing an incompatible KV cache allocation with that kernel selection. Root cause for canary.
support-liaison: Support queue: 3 customers from EU reported errors in last 10m — IDs: C-4532, C-4578, C-4621. They're hitting generation endpoints and getting 502/timeout. I sent a quick ack.
alex: Since flipping the flag mitigated, what's our mitigation plan? 1) Keep flag off for canary & roll back change from main -> patch? 2) Revert single commit abc123 on main and redeploy? Thoughts?
pranav: I'd prefer a quick revert of the single commit on release branch + patch deploy. The change is risky; revert is smaller atomic. I'll prepare the revert PR.
maria: +1 on revert. Also need to inform support + customers (support-liaison).
jen: I'll run a smoke canary after revert. Can we keep the flag off even after revert until we validate?
pranav: Yes we'll keep `enable_new_batcher=false` by default until we validate a fixed implementation.
pranav: Revert command I'll use: ```
# on release/v1.12.x
git checkout release/v1.12.x
git revert --no-edit abc123
git push origin release/v1.12.x
```
pranav: Opening PR now -> PR #1427. CI running.
incident-bot: PD page escalated to SEV-2, oncall alex acknowledged.
alex: Ping me when PR merged, I'll cut a patch release. Also will trigger canary only first.
maria: Noting customer impact: 3 customers affected, EU only, degraded success rate 40-60% for ~8 minutes. No data exfiltration.
support-liaison: I updated customers with ETA ~20-30 minutes for patch. They're asking if this is related to yesterday's optimizer rollout. I told them it's separate and we're patching.
jen: PR merged and CI green -> commit abd456 is the revert commit.
alex: Creating patch release: `make release TAG=v1.12.3-hotfix-1` then push; I'll kick off canary.
deploy-bot: Started rollout v1.12.3-hotfix-1 -> canary tier (3 pods) at 10:19Z.
jen: Can confirm canary pods come up healthy; initial gen flows succeed.
maria: Telemetry note: we lost some detailed kernel selection metrics during the tiny window because new metric pipeline config wasn't present in canary. We'll add a temporary scrapers job.
pranav: Applied `kubectl patch` to restart runtime with config fix: ```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/runtime-canary
kubectl apply -f telemetry/canary-metrics-override.yaml
```
alex: Canary stable for 6m, success rate >99%, no new 5xx. Rolling to 20% next.
support-liaison: Updating customers: hotfix deployed to canary, we're validating rollout. ETA for full rollback -> patch completion ~35m.
jen: Rolling to 20% done. Monitoring.
maria: Final rollout to 100% done at 10:39Z. Post-deploy checks green. No further customer errors reported.
pranav: Root cause: aggressive kernel selection + new batcher path exposed a corner-case in KV cache allocation. Reverting the batching change avoids the path until we redesign allocation.
alex: Oncall handoff: I'm taking incident until 11:00Z then handing to pranav for postmortem write-up.
pranav: I'll own the postmortem and follow-up for telemetry and unit tests for KV cache. Schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00Z.
support-liaison: Notified affected customers: C-4532/C-4578/C-4621 updated that service is restored and we are investigating root cause, offered incident summary.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2024-0423-01 marked RESOLVED by alex at 10:41Z.
maria: Thanks team. Action items: PR to add KV cache unit tests (pranav), telemetry patch for kernel metrics (jen), improve deploy gating to catch kernel selection flakiness (maria).
alex: Good work. I'll attach logs and the revert PR link to the incident ticket.
pranav: quick note — we'll also add a canary-only chaos test that simulates truncated sequences.
jen: I'll follow up with a daily summary in #eng-sre.
maria: handing off to pranav for postmortem. thanks everyone :heart:
